content.text: Yes, that's correct. The refund is only for the wireless charger, and you are keeping the USB-C cable 3 pack. Regarding the return of the charger, I recommend checking any return instructions that may have been provided in your order confirmation or refund notification email. If you need, I can also check if there are specific return instructions for this refund. Would you like me to do that?

Yes, please check, thanks! I'd like to know whether I need to send the charger back, and if so, how. Since it overheats, I don't want to do anything that could cause a problem. Also, could you tell me roughly how long the refund will take to show up?
